name: issue-to-pr-pipeline
description: Issue-to-PR orchestration. resolve-issue chains the review, test, and PR-lifecycle skills into one resumable pipeline (fact-check the issue, draft and harden a plan, implement, write tests, review the fix, open the PR), holding the plan-approval gate, pausing again wherever a decision is yours, and checkpointing to .claude/resolve/<ticket>/ so a fresh session can resume. resolve-issue-dashboard is a live, read-only dashboard that visualises a run by tailing the transcript and state.md.
